content: Framer Motion is now Motion. Install via: npm install motion. Import from 'motion/react' not 'framer-motion'. Current stable: v13.1.1 (Aug 2026). Supports React 18 and 19. Features: scroll-triggered animations, layout animations, AnimatePresence for exit animations, useScroll hook, useInView for viewport detection. framer-motion package still works (re-exports motion) but is the legacy name.
